title: Crash soak: every 'playing as the player' switch on while the robot fights (unattended)
intro: Runs by itself on the test bench. If you are here: just watch.

steps.text: Switches on, taking over the main pawn.
Robot fights goblins as the pawn (hit-stop, kills, sound swaps all on).
Back to the Arisen and over again (restore paths).
Take over again; robot fights a second wave.

expect.label: the game's player is the Arisen between calls

steps.text: All off, back to the Arisen.

expect.label: the Arisen is the game's player at the end

probes.mp_ok:
local d = _G.DPC_dbg
if not (d and d.R) then return "no DPC dev" end
local R = d.R
local cm = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager")
local mp = cm and cm:call("get_ManualPlayer")
local ar = d.state.arisen_chara or mp
return R.mp_swapped == nil and mp ~= nil and ar ~= nil and mp:get_address() == ar:get_address()
probes.active: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; return d and d.state.active
